title: Café — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Café.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Distinctly You." Premium tier. Cafe by GE Appliances is the customization brand. Four hardware collections — Modern Bronze, Brushed Copper, Brushed Stainless, and Matte Black — let customers personalize every handle, knob, and badge on every appliance. No other brand offers this level of mix-and-match customization. The SmartHQ app connects everything. Cafe targets millennials and Gen X who want their kitchen to feel unique, not cookie-cutter.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-obsessed customers who want their kitchen to feel personal. Pinterest/Instagram-driven renovation projects. Young professionals furnishing their dream kitchen.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Café:

• Only brand where you choose your hardware finish — 4 options on every appliance

• Swap hardware later if you change your mind — no need to buy new appliances

• Connected kitchen via SmartHQ app — control oven, check fridge, monitor laundry

• True European Convection with precise temperature management

• Customization makes every kitchen unique — your customer will never see the same setup at a neighbors house
